_note: Crew unit types and clan rules for the sim (docs/crew_recruiting_plan.md). Starting numbers, tune in playtests. Speeds and ranges in world units (the ronin is 2 tall), attackSpeed in seconds between hits, hireSeconds = queue timer, price in ryo before the crew-size step. HP doubled 2026-10-16 (Tim: died too fast). regenPerSecond = share of max HP healed per second once a unit has not been hit for regenAfterSeconds (stand-in until the hospital). 'later' types are listed but cannot be hired yet.

rules._contracts: Shinobi contracts (sim/contracts.js, Tim 2026-10-20): the village shrine posts perDawn jobs each dawn, one taken at a time, running until the next dawn; done = ryo + renown, failed = nothing. scout: hidden inside a rival business seconds; mark: at night stand on its back-room spot plantSeconds, then keep a ninja inside holdSeconds (none inside leaveSeconds = failed; owner alerted at once if seen planting, else after alertDelay; owner units on the mark clearSeconds scrub it off), done = no payout there next dawn; steal: on a rival-owned business stash seconds = share of its completion-time treasury, capped at max + capPerBusinessPoint times the target business score. Clan-target ryo/Renown scale by 1 + rewardPerBusinessPoint times target business score; accepting locks rewards and the Steal ceiling; bandit jobs stay unchanged; boss: knock out the rival boss; bandits: count bandits before dawn. Fair board (Tim 2026-10-20): at most perClan jobs on one clan; a clan hit by a done contract in the last recentDays dawns is drawn 1/(1+hits) as often, the season leader leaderWeight x; taking a job swaps the other jobs on that clan for jobs on other clans or the town (or drops them)

stealth._note: Shinobi stealth (sim/stealth.js, Tim 2026-10-20): hidden unless an enemy is within darkRange (night, no lantern), litRange (lantern light or day) or indoorRange (rooms), x runFactor running; seen, hitting or hit = revealed revealSeconds; lanterns light lightRadius; snuff snuffPerNight a night, snuffSeconds standing still within snuffReach of the lantern (Tim 2026-10-20: 7, so you are not seen doing it; hover a lantern + click or Space; Tim 2026-10-21: walking on does not cancel it, and every lantern within snuffArea of it goes out too)

rules._businesses: price = buy an unclaimed one from its building panel at the door ring (within buyReach); payout = ryo at every dawn (docs/business_raids_plan.md); data/settings.json lays over these

hideout._note: home hideouts (inn: you, izakaya: the rival clan): never taken; hiring takes hireTimeFactor x as long; heat cools heatCoolFactor x as fast while the boss is inside; hurt crew and boss inside heal restPerSecond of max HP a second

rules._houseGuards: hideouts get hideoutCount guards patrolling the room (0; bot clans set their own: hideoutGuards in bots.json, 1 easy / 2 medium+hard; harder steal, Tim 2026-10-20); every owned business comes with count house guards (type below, drawn as model), free; they stroll round inside (a few seconds at each spot) and defend, die outright, and a dead one returns at the next dawn or dusk while the clan still owns it; not part of your crew (no cap, no orders)
rules._attack: attacking an unclaimed business at night (sim/businesses.js): startSeconds to get inside, then the police come through its door perWave at a time (bigWave in the later waves, past bigWavesFrom of them); waves = the business's attackWaves (officerHp x a street officer's HP; hitting them adds hitHeat, not the usual police heat), waveGapSeconds between waves, waves + wavesPerTier x the clan's police tier waves; beat them all, then hold the back room (the floor spot furthest from the door, holdRadius) for holdSeconds; no one of yours inside for leaveSeconds or the boss down = lost; a win sets heat to what it was before + heatAfterWin, a loss to before + heatAfterLoss (the waves count is fixed when it starts)
rules._raid: raiding a rival-owned business (sim/businesses.js): needs a War Lantern (lanternPrice ryo at the moneylender's door, carry at most lanternCarry), night only, hero at the door ring; the lantern is planted by the door and used up; raiders can't go in for warmupSeconds, then up to maxCrewInside crew (plus the hero) go in and hold the back room for holdSeconds (paused while a defender stands in it); no police; the boss down or nobody inside for leaveSeconds after the doors open = lost

_models: per-sprite overrides for a unit type (sim/game.js statsOf): the Shinobi boss is a hero like the ronin, with his own numbers (Tim 2026-10-20: an assassin, faster, same damage, a bit less health); abilities Q Shadow Step, E Distract, R Smoke Bomb, F Assassinate (ninja build phase 4, Tim 2026-10-20)

Q.name: Sweeping Cut
Q.about: Sweep your spear around you: nearby visible enemies take 60% weapon damage and move 50% slower for 3 s. Does not pick fights with street police or townsfolk

E.name: Reprisal
E.about: Brace for up to 1 s. Taking damage or an enemy damaging your crew within 6 grants 6 s cleave (35% splash within 2) and your next landed normal attack stuns for 0.75 s. Your crew within 6 when the counter triggers gain 20% cleave within 2 for 3 s, with no stun. Moving before a hit instead grants +30% run speed for 4 s, including casting while already moving. Counter and speed are alternative outcomes. Finishing the brace without a hit or cancelling with Escape grants neither. Incoming damage is unchanged; speed does not stack or remove snares

R.name: Threefold Thrust
R.about: Three rapid spear thrusts at your target or the enemy at the mouse in melee reach, each dealing 45% weapon damage. Each checks reach; you stay planted. Moving or Escape cancels. Reprisal cleave applies; its stun is reserved for a normal attack

F.name: Iron Formation
F.about: Create a fixed 6-step defensive circle for 8 s. Your units inside take 25% less damage and their weapon hits briefly slow enemies 30% for 1 s. Does not heal or change crew orders. Floating crimson/gold ward symbols rotate around its edge

Q.name: Shadow Step
Q.about: Vanish and reappear up to 8 steps toward the mouse (not through walls or water); you stay hidden. Aimed at an enemy or townsperson: land next to it with a sure crit, then auto attack it

E.name: Distract
E.about: Throw caltrops at the mouse (up to 12 steps): every enemy within 4 of them is slowed 50% for 3 s, and house guards, police and bandits within 6 who aren't fighting go and look there for 6 s

R.name: Smoke Bomb
R.about: Smoke round you (4 steps, 6 s): enemies inside lose their target, nobody outside sees in, your ninja inside stay hidden and heal 3% a second. Ninja inside stop attacking. When the cloud expires, ninja still inside gain 4 s undetectable invisibility and can Assassinate immediately. Crew regroup on you and remain passive through movement/follow orders until an explicit attack or attack-move. Indoor exit rules still apply. Attacking ends invisibility; incoming damage does not reveal them

F.name: Assassinate
F.about: Only after 3 s hidden (smoke doesn't count): lunge onto the enemy at the mouse (up to about 4 away) and strike. Non-heroes go down at once. Heroes retain 60% of their current health, rounded to whole HP; cannot finish a hero. Shows you. You and crew within 8 gain +20 percentage points critical chance for 8 s; refreshes without stacking

Q.name: Iaido Dash

R.name: Rally
R.about: You and your crew within 8 steps attack 30% faster and heal 15% over 6 s

F.name: Red Lantern
F.about: 8 s of 50% more damage, healing 20% of damage dealt
